images.subject: 乌龟重画
images.prompt:
像素画，大颗粒像素风格（整幅画大约 60×60 个像素点），纯色平涂，不要渐变、不要阴影、不要抗锯齿，正方形构图，主体居中。
背景干净无杂物，无文字、无边框、无水印。
可爱的卡通小乌龟在水里游，头上戴一个很大的红色蝴蝶结，背上驮着一颗大红色泡泡。
只用 6 种颜色：背景纯浅蓝 #46D9FF（约占 70%），龟身草绿 #92EF4D（约 11%），黑色描边 #2D2D2D（约 9%），龟壳棕色 #65392D（约 6%），红色蝴蝶结和红泡泡 #FF525B（约 3.5%，要明显），脸颊一点浅肤色 #FFCAA9。
用途：游戏关卡图案的原始像素插画候选。输出一张独立的正方形插画，不要拼图、不要多视图。占比均指整个画面面积，尽量接近给定比例，最大面积的背景是单一纯色。所有小比例颜色都必须出现并形成可辨认的小部件。所有像素大小一致且沿同一粗像素网格排列，边缘硬朗。提示词中的阴影或高光仅指指定颜色的平面色块，禁止柔和阴影、渐变、发光、材质和额外颜色。不要添加未指定的黑色或白色。画面不含任何文字、色卡、比例标签或网格线。

Create ONE standalone square pixel-art game illustration on a solid opaque background. A rigid, consistent 60 by 60 coarse pixel grid, large hard-edged square pixels. All regions are completely flat digital paint, without texture, gradients, smooth shading, glows, or antialiasing. No text, no visible grid, no swatches, no border, no watermark. Subject: a cute round cartoon turtle swimming, a conspicuous red bow on its head and one red bubble carried on its shell. Color budget on a 3600-cell canvas: solid cyan #46D9FF background 2526 cells (70%); grass-green #92EF4D head and four flippers 408 cells (11.3%); charcoal #2D2D2D thin outline, eyes and shell divisions 317 cells (8.8%); brown #65392D shell 213 cells (5.9%); red #FF525B bow plus bubble TOGETHER 123 cells (3.4%); peach #FFCAA9 cheek dots 13 cells (0.36%). The turtle's green/brown body must be large enough; red accessories should be visible but their combined area MUST be only 3.4%, not 6–10%. The bow is large relative to its knot, with compact lobes; the red bubble is about half the area of the bow. The brown shell has more area than both red parts together. Keep the background empty. No white anywhere, no unrelated bubbles, no scenery.
